components.name: Primary Button
components.description: One filled Berry Ink action per view, with its keycap.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">Show twins on this page <kbd class="ds-keycap">T</kbd></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;height:32px;padding:6px 12px;border:0;border-radius:12px;background:oklch(0.48 0.17 355);color:oklch(0.99 0.006 355);font:550 13px/20px 'Rethink Sans Variable',system-ui,sans-serif;transition:background-color 100ms,transform 100ms}.ds-btn-primary:hover{background:oklch(0.43 0.16 355)}.ds-btn-primary:active{transform:scale(.97)}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid oklch(0.48 0.17 355);outline-offset:2px}.ds-keycap{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;min-width:20px;height:20px;padding:0 5px;border-radius:8px;background:oklch(0.958 0.007 345);color:oklch(0.46 0.02 345);border:1px solid oklch(0.905 0.01 345);box-shadow:inset 0 -1px 0 oklch(0.905 0.01 345);font:600 11px/16px 'Rethink Sans Variable',system-ui,sans-serif}

narrative.overview: A photographer's contact sheet is a grid of near-identical frames, and the photographer's tools are a china marker and a loupe: circle the frames that match, then lean in and check. Factory Twins hands the shopper the marker (rings in shared colours), a way to gather the circled frames onto one strip (the fold card's price ladder), and the loupe (the Proof lens). Quiet where the shopper works, loud where they discover.
keyCharacteristics: Light-first blush-neutral paper with a berry-ink accent used as a signal.
Six equal-lightness twin colours, each with a letter and ring pattern.
Bricolage Grotesque only at discovery moments; Rethink Sans everywhere else.
Soft-plus radii; pills only for status objects; rectangular buttons.
Depth by tone and hairlines; shadow only on floating layers.
One choreographed fold; everything frequent is instant.

rules.name: The Marker Belongs to the Shopper Rule
rules.body: Twin colours mark the shopper's results and the landing blocks that tell their story. They never colour a button, a focus ring, a nav item or our logo.

rules.name: The One Berry Rule
rules.body: At most one filled Berry Ink button per view, and Berry Ink covers 5% or less of any screen's pixels.

rules.name: The Pencil Floor Rule
rules.body: text-subtle is for meta labels on bg or surface only; on surface-2 use text-muted.

rules.name: The Three Places Rule
rules.body: Bricolage appears in at most three places per screen, and on the store page only inside the fold card and the Proof lens.

rules.name: The Never Shout Rule
rules.body: No uppercase eyebrows, no letter-spaced labels, no weight above 700, no single coloured or italic word in a headline.

rules.name: The Zero-Shift Rule
rules.body: Nothing rendered before the shopper presses F changes the size or position of a store element.

rules.name: The No Glass Rule
rules.body: No backdrop-filter anywhere. Opaque surfaces only.

dos: Do write "Same photo ×5" and "These 5 listings use the same photo"; show ratings and review counts under every rung so the shopper decides.
Do keep one filled Berry Ink button per view, and put the keycap beside every action that has a key.
Do pair every twin colour with its letter and ring pattern, and every semantic colour with an icon.
Do render frequent actions (rings, popup, pill result) at 0 ms, and spend motion only on the fold and the cancel-to-black.
Do use the store's own thumbnail URLs for every photo we display on the store page; never inject data URLs or our own copies.
Do use one colour block per landing viewport, in a twin soft tint, with Blush Paper between blocks.
donts: Don't write "same item", "same product", "identical product", "dupe" or "knockoff" anywhere.
Don't use Berry Ink for a ring, badge, ladder bar or price.
Don't shift, restyle or reorder the store's grid before the shopper folds, and don't leave anything behind after unfold.

Don't use backdrop-filter, gradients as decoration, uppercase eyebrows, middle-dot meta strings in UI text (draw dividers instead), emoji, or → appended to buttons (the pill's → is data: listings become products).
Don't use Bricolage on the pill, rings or badges, or above weight 700.
Don't show store logos or trade dress in demos, screenshots or the landing page; demo listings are made up and say so.
